    <h1>Guild Wars 2 setup</h1>

<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
The Guild Wars 2 module brings raid and Fractals sign-ups by squad role and build, characters with their profession, World vs World and meta nights, and loot for your guild. Finish [**Setting up Alagos**](/guides/setting-up/) first.

## 1. Switch it on

Run `/guild-settings modules` and press **Switch on** beside **Guild Wars 2**. Its tab appears in `/guild-settings show`.

## 2. Characters

Your members add their own characters: the name, the **profession**, the **build** they play (the core profession or an elite specialization, from a menu that shows only that profession's), a second build, their **account name** (Name.1234) and a logs link (dps.report or Wingman). Officers can add or fix anyone's.

## 3. Squad roles

A squad signs up by what each player brings: **Tank**, **Healer**, **Support** (boons such as Quickness and Alacrity) and **DPS**. In Guild Wars 2 a build fills any of these by its gear, so a member presses the role they are playing tonight and keeps their build: a Herald can sign up as Support one night and Healer the next.

## 4. Templates

Press **New event** and pick one by name:

- **Raid night (10)** and **Guardian's Glade (10)**: 1 tank, 2 healers, 2 support, 5 DPS. **Start from** also offers a squad with no tank.
- **Fractals (5)**: 1 healer, 1 support, 3 DPS.
- **World vs World night**, **Meta train** and **Guild missions**, with no fixed slots (or a World vs World squad of 50 from **Start from**).

Change the slots on any event for your squad's plan.

## 5. Coming from Raid-Helper

**📥 Import from Raid-Helper** on the **Features & limits** tab takes Raid-Helper's Guild Wars 2 events: each sign-up comes in with the role pressed and the build.
